name: Kazuno (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kazuno city emblem in white: a disc crossed by a diagonal stroke, with a small ring at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Kazuno, a city in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 December 1972.

features.role: Kazuno city emblem — a disc crossed by a diagonal stroke, with a small ring at the fly
